steps.title: Roll selected resistance target
steps.action: Use one Pristine + Prismatic Fossil combination in a two-socket chaotic resonator.
steps.continueWhen: Life at least 130, Fire Resistance at least 42% and Cold Resistance at least 42%. This is a selected concrete SKU, not every good belt.
steps.failureAction: Repeat the paid roll on the same base; previous explicits are discarded. Stop on the selected finished target; no catalyst or speculative corruption is required.
